description: On the E046 tip, double the LR warmup length (0.23 -> 0.46 of the warmup fraction in steps) for both the SGD and Muon groups, keeping the same peak and the same decay end point. Change nothing else. This is the untested direction after E051, where halving the warmup cost ~0.2 pp.
